records.text: Charlie Kirk wanted to attend West Point but instead started Turning Point USA when he was 18 years old.

appearances.snippet: Charlie wanted to go to West Point and then instead started Turning Point USA when he was 18 years old.

verification.notes: Independent reporting documents that Kirk wanted to attend West Point, was rejected, and launched Turning Point USA in 2012 at age 18. The transcript's wording that he started TPUSA instead of attending West Point is a fair summary of that sequence.

sources.title: How Charlie Kirk shaped a generation of young people into a conservative force
sources.relevance: AP reports that Kirk launched Turning Point USA at 18 after rejection from West Point.
